messages:
aya: Heads-up — Console metrics page is freezing on first open for some customers, 3–6s of jank before charts render. I have a flame chart attached and perf traces.
ben: Saw alerts for Dashboard route too, p95 long-task spikes after last release.
aya: Repro steps: open /projects/123/metrics with a large timespan, noticed long main-thread tasks and a huge eval time for vendor chunks.
carla: Any CDN 5xx or cache misses?
aya: CDN hit ratio looks fine (~92%) but sourcemaps show huge parse/compile cost in the browser. Vendor chunk ~1.1MB gz.
dom: Quick glance: the route ends up importing the full charts bundle plus visx and a d3 utils lib pulled in by a shared utils file. I think we pulled a synchronous import in the route-level component.
elaine: Can you paste the import pattern?
aya: Sure — problematic code:
```js
// src/routes/metrics/index.tsx
import { LineChart } from 'charts-lib' // charts-lib bundles visx + d3 into one
// then render <LineChart /> directly in SSR/CSR path
```
aya: Because we import directly at module top-level, the charts chunk becomes critical and gets parsed immediately on route entry. On low-powered devices that kills FCP/TTI.
ben: Also telemetry shows this only spikes for customers with many metric series (bigger datasets) but even without data parse cost is the main problem.
carla: Related to recent rollout of shared-utils that re-exported some chart helpers? Could be inadvertent re-export pulling d3 into common chunk.
dom: Proposed quick mitigation: lazy-load chart component with suspense and render a light placeholder until chunk arrives. Also prefetch the chunk on hover/route-intent.
elaine: Example change?
dom: 
```js
// lazy load
const LineChart = lazy(() => import('charts-lib/LineChart'))
// or dynamic import with webpackPrefetch: true
const LineChart = lazy(() => import(/* webpackPrefetch: true */ 'charts-lib/LineChart'))
```
aya: Another option: ship a tiny static SVG snapshot from server for initial paint, then hydrate with full chart once chunk ready — reduces perceived jank.
ben: From bundler side we should dedupe visx and ensure splitChunks creates a stable vendor chunk, not duplicate across microfrontends. Also compress and enable br compression if missing.
carla: I'll audit shared-utils exports to see if we accidentally imported entire d3 namespace. If so we can narrow exports.
deploy-bot: Deploy by ben completed at 2026-02-12T17:03:22Z :white_check_mark:
aya: Telemetry asks: can we add a custom trace span around dynamic import so we can measure chunk load vs parse? Right now our traces conflate network and main-thread.
ben: Yes — instrument with performance.mark/measure around the import and emit to telemetry. Also add a metric for main-thread long tasks on first paint per route.
elaine: For short-term hotfix, I can ship lazy + prefetch on canary and add placeholder snapshot. Who owns the roll?
aya: Elaine takes hotfix. Dom + Carla to follow with bundler/audit. Ben to add telemetry spans and a canary rollout plan (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
dom: One more thought: we should consider an LRU in-memory cache for rendered chart images for fast route re-entry — cheaper than re-parsing on every visit.
carla: Filing a ticket with findings and suggested PRs. TL;DR: immediate lazy+prefetch hotfix, medium-term chunk dedupe and export narrowing, long-term SSR snapshot + image cache.
ben: Thanks — please tag me on the ticket and I'll coordinate rollout policy in the console. :thumbsup:
elaine: I'll open the PR now and drop the canary link here when ready.
aya: Thanks team — keeping an eye on alerts.
